facts.fact: A new UV layer on a mesh without UVs is not empty: each face gets the whole unit square (its corners at the square's corners; triangles use three of them)
A UV map is an attribute: a FLOAT2 on the CORNER domain, under the UV map's name

facts.result: ERROR Operator bpy.ops.uv.smart_project.poll() failed, context is incorrect

facts.fact: Smart UV Project's angle_limit is in radians (default 1.1519 = 66 degrees; soft range to 1.5533 = 89 degrees, hard limit 1.5708 = 90). Passing 66, meaning degrees, raises nothing: it is clamped to the hard limit, and the islands match 90 degrees, not 66
uv.smart_project works headless once the object is active, in edit mode with its faces selected; on a 32 x 16 UV sphere it gives these islands, inside the unit square
uv.unwrap splits along seams (edge.use_seam, set here through bmesh's edge.seam): a cylinder with seams around both caps and down one side unwraps into 3 islands with each method 4.5 offers

uv.pack_islands acts on islands selected in the UV editor's own selection, not the mesh's: after Smart UV Project, with the faces selected, it returned CANCELLED; with tool_settings.use_uv_select_sync = True (UV selection follows the mesh) it packed
uv.lightmap_pack gives every face of a cube its own island

UVs from arrays: uv_layer.uv.foreach_set('vector', flat_array) per corner is far faster than a loop over uv_layer.data (marked deprecated in 4.5, still working); corners map to vertices through loops.vertex_index

bmesh: bm.loops.layers.uv.verify() returns the active UV layer, creating one if there is none, and that new layer is named 'Float2', not 'UVMap'; bm.loops.layers.uv.new('UVMap') names it. loop[layer].uv sets a corner's UV
